title: A linked Part Library entry keeps its tags and gains the new ones
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TAGS-01) is stocked at {Location-B} only and carries exactly two tags, {Tag-A} (for example ZZTAGOLD1) and {Tag-B} (for example ZZTAGOLD2).
  • {Location-A} stocks no part numbered {Part-A}.
  • The tag you will add is {Tag-C} (for example ZZTAGNEW3).
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a Description (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Tags Library).
  3. Type {Part-A} in Part Number, exactly as written down.
  4. Click Tags.
  5. Type {Tag-C} and press Enter.
  6. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  7. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  8. Click Save.
  9. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: the part is saved and the window closes.
  • Step 9: the one {Part-A} row shows three tags, {Tag-A}, {Tag-B} and {Tag-C} (2 kept + 1 added = 3). None was removed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R6a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Number and description typed), board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R6a: “A linked entry keeps all its tags. Tags typed on the new part are added to them, and none are removed.”
